run_prep_sn_output_data: run the script to prepare speech normalizer output data from unit and audio TSV files
run_process_function: run the process function to merge unit sequences with audio sample IDs into an output text file
create_output_from_units_and_audio: create an output text file by combining speech normalizer unit sequences with audio sample identifiers
parse_args_for_preprocessing: parse command line arguments for the speech to speech preprocessing script with in-unit, in-audio, and output-root
review_process_function: review the process function that loads unit sequences and maps them to audio sample IDs
